init_hook: echo '🚀 Devbox environment ready for LearnFinance-2025'
echo '   Run "devbox run --list" to see available commands'

brain:run: cd brain_api && uv sync --all-extras && uv run uvicorn brain_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
brain:test: cd brain_api && uv sync --all-extras && uv run pytest --durations=0 --durations-min=0.5
brain:lint: cd brain_api && uv sync --all-extras && uv run ruff check .
brain:format: cd brain_api && uv sync --all-extras && uv run ruff format .
temporal:worker:training: cd temporal && TEMPORAL_TASK_QUEUE=learnfinance-training TEMPORAL_MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIVITIES=1 uv run python -m worker
temporal:worker:inference: cd temporal && TEMPORAL_TASK_QUEUE=learnfinance-inference uv run python -m worker
temporal:schedule: cd temporal && uv run python -m schedules
temporal:test: cd temporal && uv sync --all-extras && uv run pytest
temporal:lint: cd temporal && uv sync --all-extras && uv run ruff check .
temporal:format: cd temporal && uv sync --all-extras && uv run ruff format .
temporal:run:us-sac-weekly: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USWeeklyAllocationWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id us-sac-weekly-manual
temporal:run:us-sac-halal-allocate: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USSACHalalAllocationWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id us-sac-halal-allocate-manual
temporal:run:us-forecasters-training: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USForecastersTrainingWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-training --workflow-id us-forecasters-training-manual
temporal:run:us-sac-training: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USSACTrainingWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-training --workflow-id us-sac-training-manual
temporal:run:us-sac-halal-training: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USSACHalalTrainingWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-training --workflow-id us-sac-halal-training-manual
temporal:run:india-alpha-hrp: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type IndiaWeeklyAllocationWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id india-alpha-hrp-manual
temporal:run:india-double-hrp: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type IndiaDoubleHRPWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id india-double-hrp-manual
temporal:run:us-double-hrp: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USDoubleHRPWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id us-double-hrp-manual
temporal:run:us-alpha-hrp: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type USAlphaHRPWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-inference --workflow-id us-alpha-hrp-manual
temporal:run:india-training: cd temporal && temporal workflow start --type IndiaWeeklyTrainingWorkflow --task-queue learnfinance-training --workflow-id india-training-manual
